name: Benice
source:
Your life has always been normal - until that fateful day in which everything changed. You got yourself involved in the dark side of Venice, and now you will never escape - or not? There are many creatures trapped the same as you - some struggling to find their way back home, some trying to rule their new forever home. They usually form packs, because only the most powerful among them can roam Benice alone and hope to survive.  

Join a pack and forge your own fate in the city of the eternal twilight!

[From [url=https://syvalki.itch.io/benice]itch.io[/url]]
